title: Exclusive: I'm Dating a Dark Summoner Omake Shorts Premieres on HIDIVE on November 6, Key Visual and Trailer Revealed
content: I’m Dating a Dark Summoner Omake Shorts will premiere exclusively on HIDIVE on November 6 as a 12-episode bonus series based on the Fall 2026 anime I’m Dating a Dark Summoner . The short-form series reimagines Amona, Roni, and the rest of the cast in chibi-style sketch comedy scenarios.
author: Anime Corner

title: Naruto Live-Action Movie Confirms Filming Starts Soon With New Sony Team Up
content: Naruto is now in the works on a brand new live-action feature film from the director behind Spider-Man: Brand New Da y , and now the project is getting a boost from Sony Pictures as production has been confirmed to kick off very soon.
author: ComicBook

title: Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 Confirms Netflix Release Date With New Teaser – Watch
content: Blue Eye Samurai is one of the most anticipated franchises coming back to Netflix next year, and now a release date has been set for Season 2 with a new teaser trailer helping to show it all off.
author: ComicBook

title: New Girls Band Cry Anime Film's Teaser Unveils May 21 Opening
content: A teaser video and key visual for Girls Band Cry the Movie , the brand-new film for the Girls Band Cry anime, debuted on Tuesday, and the teaser announces that Toei will open the film on May 21, 2027. The teaser also teases that the TOGENASHI TOGEARI band is going on a national tour in the film's story.
author: ANN

title: emaqi Service Adds Naruto, Kaiju No. 8, Spy x Family, 2 More Viz Media Titles; 8 New Exclusive Manga
content: AI localization company Orange Inc. announced on Tuesday that its emaqi e-bookstore service is adding eight new exclusive titles this month. Five of the new titles will be available through its " emaqi Premium" monthly subscription service.
author: ANN

title: Mari Okada, Makoto Ojiro's Sister Resistar Manga Ends in 2 Chapters
content: This year's 49th issue of Shogakukan 's Big Comic Spirits magazine announced on Monday that Mari Okada and Makoto Ojiro 's Sistar Resistar manga will end in two chapters. The manga's next chapter will run in the magazine's 51st issue on November 16. If there are no delays, the manga will end on November 23.
author: ANN

title: 'Kawaii dake ja Nai Shikimori-san' Creator Begins 'Mahoutsukai no Yoru' Manga Adaptation
content: Manga creator Keigo Maki ( Kawaii dake ja Nai Shikimori-san ) will draw a manga adaptation of Type-Moon 's Mahoutsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ) visual novel, the official X (formerly Twitter) account of the manga announced on Tuesday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Ramparts of Ice Manga Gets Epilogue Chapter in Fan Book
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Kōcha Agasawa 's The Ramparts of Ice ( Koori no Jyōheki or Ice Castle Wall ) manga announced on October 29 that the manga will have a fan book that will ship on January 4, and the fan book will include an exclusive new epilogue chapter set after the main manga series'…

title: Girls Band Cry THE MOVIE Reveals Teaser Visual, Trailer, May 21 Release Date
content: The previously teased Girls Band Cry THE MOVIE revealed a teaser visual and trailer on Monday, along with a May 21, 2027, release date. Toei Animation continues producing the movie, with Kazuo Sakai as director. Jukki Hanada also returns to write the script with Kenji Tamai composing the music.
author: Anime Corner

title: I'm Not Even an NPC In This Otome Game! Manga Ends
content: Square Enix 's Manga UP! platform started publishing the final chapter of writer Gyokuro and artist Meno Himeno 's I'm Not Even an NPC In This Otome Game! manga on Tuesday. Manga UP! describes the story: Taichi was reincarnated as Isaac, an apprentice gardener in the world of an otome game.
author: ANN
